Make a word from the plate.

Each plate has three letters. Type any English word or name that uses them in that order, with other letters anywhere in between. Names of places, people and brands count, like Brooklyn or Bolivia. You get 45 seconds per plate, five plates a day. Stuck? A hint shows up halfway through, and after 20 seconds you can skip.

Plate RNB

The more niche your answer, the farther you drive. Common words keep you on the Interstate; rare ones take you down back roads and dirt roads nobody drives. You won't know how far a word goes until you press Enter.
